fullContentHtml:
UPSC Engineering Services Pre Online Form 2027 - Complete Details

Short Information : Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the notification for the post of Engineering Service Examination 2027 on the official website. This recruitment was released for 480 posts. The online application process for UPSC Engineering Services Pre Recruitment 2027 will start from 26 September 2026, and candidates can apply until 06 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details of UPSC Engineering Services Pre Recruitment 2027 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 26 September 2026
  • Last Date : 06 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 October 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 31 January 2027
  • Mains Exam Date : 18 June 2027
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, SC, Female, PH : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Important Links

  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSC Engineering Services Pre Online Form 2027?

UPSC Engineering Services Pre Online Form 2027 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 06 October 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://upsc.gov.in/whats-new

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
